mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS (USER_ID, USER_PWD, USER_NICKNAME, USER_AGE, IS_REGISTERED_BUSINESS) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userPwd}, #{userNickname}, #{userAge}, #{isRegisteredBusiness})
mapper.select: SELECT USER_IDX AS userIdx, USER_ID AS userId, USER_PWD AS userPwd, USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, USER_AGE AS userAge, IS_REGISTERED_BUSINESS AS isRegisteredBusiness FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
